propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled using only structural signals: REVERT of STATUS/COMMITS events infer regression; plan-review BLOCK verdicts infer plan_defect; gate_error_v1 ERROR records infer env_integration; all others infer undetermined.

Backfilled classifications are written to a git-tracked NDJSON artifact (.rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson) segregated from authoritative close_class values, with each record carrying source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to prevent contamination.
The backfill script is idempotent: it skips any ticket_id already present in the artifact and any bug with an existing authoritative close_class, re-running appends no duplicates.

Plan-review BLOCK signals must be queried via all_review_results() while gate_error_v1 signals require raw event-file scanning (globbing *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json), as all_review_results silently filters out gate_error records.
REVERT signals must target substantive events (STATUS or COMMITS), not metadata events (COMMENT/LINK), to infer regression.
Backfilled values carry source=backfill_classified with is_authoritative() returning False, ensuring registry segregation from authoritative structural series.
